meta.name: x-api
meta.description: X/Twitter API integration for posting tweets, threads, reading timelines, search, and analytics. Covers OAuth auth patterns, rate limits, and platform-native content posting. Use when the user wants to interact with X programmatically.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过 API 自动发推、读时间线、搜索和分析数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码操作 X/Twitter 账号
copy.tagline_en: Automate posting, reading timelines, searching, and analytics via X API
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to programmatically interact with X/Twitter

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以发推文、发推文串、读时间线、搜索推文、看分析数据，还能上传图片发推。
howto.when: 当你说“发推”、“发帖到 X”、“用 X API”或“Twitter API”时，或者你想用程序操作 X 账号时触发。

say.text: 帮我发一条推文，内容是“今天天气真好”。
say.note: Claude 会调用 X API 发推。

say.text: 搜索最近关于 AI 的推文。
say.note: Claude 会搜索并返回结果。

say.text: 读取我的时间线，显示最近 5 条推文。
say.note: Claude 会获取你的时间线。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can post tweets and threads, read timelines, search tweets, view analytics, and upload media to post.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'post to X', 'tweet', 'X API', or 'Twitter API', or when you want to interact with X programmatically.

say_en.note: Claude will call X API to post.

say_en.text: Search for recent tweets about AI.
say_en.note: Claude will search and return results.

say_en.text: Read my timeline and show the last 5 tweets.
